cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: The Logic Gets Bigger
cards.instruction: Use every new detail to expand the impossible system, its history, and the consequences of breaking it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Our soup bowl said hello. Use the formal greeting; crockery stopped speaking after the Great Washing-Up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Trade has reopened. Offer a roll, but keep the butter separate; mixed gifts caused the gravy embargo.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's asking for a seat at dinner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's recognition as a nation. Move the plates apart before we accidentally concede its borders.

mechanism: A treats its former hospitality pupil talking-bowl responses as a diplomatic exercise, adding trade history and territorial consequences to each new request.
confusable: Not merely polite service to an unusual guest: bread and seating expand a connected political system with historical failures and risks.
comparison: Office administrative escalation versus dinner diplomacy through corrected hospitality.
seedUse: D168 greeting/Great Washing-Up/bread/gravy embargo/seat/borders; S05 taught greeting and gift habits.
